subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use the title and diagrams to find the main idea of a report.
Understand facts about plastic pollution in the sea.
Learn report words like tonne, foundation and government.

tf.s: By 2050, there will be more plastic than fish in the sea.
tf.why: Yes, the report says plastic will be more than fish.

tf.s: 8 million tonnes of plastic go into the ocean every year.
tf.why: Correct! That is a huge amount.

tf.s: 50 years ago, we made twenty times less plastic than we do today.
tf.why: Right! We make much more plastic now.

tf.s: The report says only children must work together to protect the oceans.
tf.why: Businesses and governments must work together.

tf.s: Reading the title and the first paragraph helps you get the main idea.
tf.why: Great tip! The title, first paragraph and diagrams show the main idea.
Yes, safe and dangerous are opposites.

tf.s: Diagrams in a report make the information harder to understand.
tf.why: Diagrams help readers see the information quickly.

tf.s: Plastic should always end up in the sea as rubbish.
tf.why: Plastic should never end up in the sea.

There will be no plastic in the sea.

o: The title, the first paragraph and the diagrams
mcq.why: This reading tip helps you predict the topic.

mcq.q: Which action helps reduce plastic pollution?
mcq.why: Reusable bottles mean less plastic rubbish.

mcq.why: The report says businesses and governments must work together.

mcq.q: Only 5% of plastics are recycled. What does this tell us?
o: Most plastic is not recycled, so it can end up as rubbish.
mcq.why: 95% is not recycled, which is a big problem.

mcq.q: How does the ratio diagram help readers?
o: It compares plastic and fish in the sea.
It shows the price of plastic.

o: We make much more plastic today.
Plastic was not invented 50 years ago.
